name: Sawtooth sunflower
desc: Sawtooth sunflower (Helianthus grosseserratus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Helianthus grosseserratus, commonly known as sawtooth sunflower or thick-tooth sunflower, is a perennial sunflower in the family Asteraceae, with a large flowering head (inflorescence).
